# MacTweaks 0.4.0
The first public release.
- **Window Grip**: hold a modifier and drag anywhere in a window to move or resize it. - **Cursor Jump**: shortcuts that move the cursor between displays. - **Tile Link**: windows that share an edge resize together. - **Mouse & Trackpad**: three-finger trackpad click or tap and two-finger Magic Mouse click act as a middle click; middle-click paste of the selected text. - Updates now arrive automatically. Check by hand with **Check for Updates…** in the menu.
